annotations.title: Base ERC-20 token facts and risk flags

description: Base only (other chains: <chain>_token_info). Live on-chain facts for an ERC-20 token on Base: name, symbol, decimals, total supply, owner and whether ownership is renounced, paused state, proxy detection (EIP-1967, minimal proxy) with implementation and admin, and bytecode heuristics for mint, pause, blacklist and fee-setter functions. Use for token due diligence and rug-pull or honeypot screening before a swap. Example: address=0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
